}

                            has_trait = wraith_trait

                            has_trait = lich_trait

omni_spellbook_cast.47 = { # explosion
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { omni_sb_can_cast_explosion = yes }
            scope:target = {
                random_character_unit = {
                    limit = { is_army = yes unit_location = { owner = { war_with = root } NOT = { has_province_modifier = shoishoni_folk_mod } } }
                    unit_location = {
                        add_city_smoke_effect = yes
                        add_city_fire_effect = yes
                        ordered_pops_in_province = {
                            order_by = pop_hapiness
                            max = {
                                value = total_population
                                divide = 5
                            }
                            min = {
                                value = 0
                            }
                            kill_pop = yes
                        }
                        add_province_modifier = {
                            name = shoishoni_folk_mod
                            duration = 64
                        }
                    }
                }
                omni_spell_mana_cost_effect = { BASE = 75 }
            }
            scope:selected_mage = { set_variable = { name = omni_cd_explosion days = 90 } }
        }
    }
}

                1 = { add_innovation = 1 }
                1 = { add_innovation = 2 }
                1 = { add_innovation = 3 }
            }
            scope:selected_mage = { set_variable = { name = omni_cd_revelation_ii days = 180 } }
        }
    }
}

omni_spellbook_cast.102 = { # rock_slide
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { omni_sb_can_cast_rock_slide = yes }
            scope:target = {
                random_character_unit = {
                    limit = { is_army = yes unit_location = { owner = { war_with = root } NOT = { has_province_modifier = amten_elementalist_spell_t2_2_mod } } }
                    unit_location = {
                        add_city_smoke_effect = yes
                        add_city_fire_effect = yes
                        ordered_pops_in_province = {
                            order_by = pop_hapiness
                            max = {
                                value = total_population
                                divide = 4
                            }
                            min = {
                                value = 0
                            }
                            kill_pop = yes
                        }
                        add_province_modifier = {
                            name = amten_elementalist_spell_t2_2_mod
                            duration = 64
                        }
                    }
                }
                omni_spell_mana_cost_effect = { BASE = 75 }
            }
            scope:selected_mage = { set_variable = { name = omni_cd_rock_slide days = 90 } }
        }
    }
}

omni_spellbook_cast.115 = { # summon_animal_auxiliaries
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { omni_sb_can_cast_summon_animal_auxiliaries = yes }
            scope:target = {
                omni_spell_mana_cost_effect = { BASE = 75 }
            }
            create_unit = {
                navy = no
                name = "Light Animal Auxiliaries"
                location = capital_scope
                hidden_effect = {
                    while = {
                        count = 4
                        add_subunit = heavy_infantry
                    }
                    while = {
                        count = 2
                        add_subunit = heavy_cavalry
                    }
                    add_food = 800
                    add_morale = 5
                }
            }
            scope:selected_mage = { set_variable = { name = omni_cd_summon_animal_auxiliaries days = 365 } }
        }
    }
}

omni_spellbook_cast.116 = { # summon_dryads
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { omni_sb_can_cast_summon_dryads = yes omni_sb_can_target_summon_dryads = yes }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:target
                    scope:player = { NOT = { has_variable = omni_summon_dryads_cooldown } }
                    scope:target = {
                        owner = scope:player
                        omni_spell_target_forest = yes
                    }
                    scope:selected_mage = {
                        OR = { employer = scope:player country = scope:player }
                        omni_can_select_territory_summon_dryads = yes
                        omni_can_afford_spell = { BASE = 100 }
                    }
                }
                scope:selected_mage = {
                    omni_spell_mana_cost_effect = { BASE = 100 }
                    save_scope_as = dryad_caster
                }
                scope:player = {
                    set_variable = { name = omni_summon_dryads_cooldown days = 365 }
                    create_unit = {
                        navy = no
                        name = "Thornwood Dryads"
                        location = scope:target
                        hidden_effect = {
                            while = { count = omni_dryad_cohort_count add_subunit = omni_dryad }
                            add_food = 800
                            add_morale = 5
                        }
                    }
                }
                scope:target = { add_province_modifier = { name = summon_dryads_mod duration = 365 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { omni_sb_can_cast_summon_warborn = yes }
            scope:target = {
                omni_spell_mana_cost_effect = { BASE = 75 }
            }
            create_unit = {
                navy = no
                name = "Undead Auxiliaries"
                location = capital_scope
                hidden_effect = {
                    while = {

                    }
                    add_food = 300
                    add_morale = 5
                }
            }
            create_character = {
                first_name = "Larry"
                age = 25
                culture = warborn
                religion = blood_tainted_pantheon
                female = no
                save_scope_as = skelebro
            }
            set_global_variable = omni_warborn_summoned # PERF gate for me_zorgo_magic_focus.23 (00_monthly_country.txt)     
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:skelebro = {
                    add_martial=15
                    force_add_trait="tactician"
                    force_add_trait="aggressive"
                }
            }
            scope:selected_mage = { set_variable = { name = omni_cd_summon_warborn days = 365 } }
        }
    }
}
